content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson focuses on **Introduction to Pandas Input and Output**. Work through the listed subtopics (Understanding the I/O API, Reader functions and writer methods, Paths, file objects, and in-memory data, Choosing an appropriate file format) as decisions in one small data workflow: identify the input and its labels, choose the relevant Pandas operation, then inspect the output shape, values, and types. Do not assume the result is correct solely because the code ran.

common_mistakes.problem: Assuming imported data already has the intended schema.
common_mistakes.why: I/O parsing can infer a wrong dtype, encoding, delimiter, date, or missing-value rule.
common_mistakes.fix: Declare or validate the schema after loading and record relevant reader options.

common_mistakes.problem: Using the operation without considering missing values or duplicate keys.
common_mistakes.why: Those records may change totals, group sizes, or join cardinality.
common_mistakes.fix: State the policy and test an example containing the relevant edge case.
